Hold on. Family relationship is not consent, and a withdrawn consent is an explicit “no” from the patient herself. A sent Zalo message cannot be recalled — this one would put Hoa's clinical detail in front of someone she has refused. Urgency justifies replying fast; it never justifies replying with that. Let's take the path that is both quick and permitted.

Hold on. Junk? would zero the urgency, drop a distressed family off the wall, mark the contact as spam and flag that phone number for every future call. In home care, a son or daughter messaging on a patient's behalf is the normal case — the question it raises is consent, not spam.

You are about to take a live channel out of service
Every inbound and outbound message on the Hà Nội Zalo Official Account, for as long as the connection is walking the path back to Connected.
The connection is, yes. The traffic is not — nothing queues while a channel is out. Messages sent to the OA during the gap do not arrive later; they simply never reach you.
That you hold the provider login now, that you know which Official Account this connection must end up on, and that you are not doing this during the morning peak.
Two accounts, one right answer, no warning either way

The provider returns both of the clinic's Official Accounts and lists them by creation date, so TPHCM comes first. Pick it and every readiness check still passes — the connection would be perfectly healthy and pointed at the wrong city. Nothing errors; the Hà Nội desk just has a quiet week.

Hold on — that is the Hồ Chí Minh City account, and it is listed first only because the provider sorts by creation date. Selecting it here would leave the Hà Nội connection pointing at the TPHCM OA: from the next message onward, Hà Nội's traffic would land on the TPHCM wall.
